@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Can you read this sentence for me? Your h______g is so messy that I can't read it.
= handwriting
~詞義 handwriting（n.）筆跡
~原文 Can you read this sentence for me? Your handwriting is so messy that I can't read it.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: During my free time, I like to go to the a______m and look at the colorful fish.
= aquarium
~詞義 aquarium（n.）水族館
~原文 During my free time, I like to go to the aquarium and look at the colorful fish.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jack bid f______l to his girlfriend from the platform as the train went off.
= farewell
~詞義 farewell（n.）送別
~原文 Jack bid farewell to his girlfriend from the platform as the train went off.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: To build the tunnel, the crew had to use heavy m______y to dig deep into the ground.
= machinery
~詞義 machinery（n.）機器
~原文 To build the tunnel, the crew had to use heavy machinery to dig deep into the ground.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Oscar is lost in the forest and unable to determine his o______n.
= orientation
~詞義 orientation（n.）方向;方位
~原文 Oscar is lost in the forest and unable to determine his orientation.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Rather than classical, realistic paintings, Mary prefers the more modern, ______ style.
A: abstract
B: promising
C: nutritious
D: damp
= A
~詞義 abstract（adj.）抽象的
~原文 Rather than classical, realistic paintings, Mary prefers the more modern, abstract style.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: If you are on a diet, you should avoid eating fried foods because they are high in ______.
A: priorities
B: options
C: calories
D: idioms
= C
~詞義 calorie（n.）卡路里
~原文 If you are on a diet, you should avoid eating fried foods because they are high in calories.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Male citizens in Taiwan with dual ______ often face difficult choices regarding military service, voting rights, and long-term personal identity.
A: recreation
B: lifeguard
C: nationality
D: publicity
= C
~詞義 nationality（n.）國籍
~原文 Male citizens in Taiwan with dual nationality often face difficult choices regarding military service, voting rights, and long-term personal identity.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The project has been ______ owing to a lack of funds.
A: paced
B: halted
C: sued
D: raged
= B
~詞義 halt（v.）暫停
~原文 The project has been halted owing to a lack of funds.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: When the teacher announced the upcoming exam, the entire class moved up a(n) ______ and began studying far more seriously.
A: panel
B: orbit
C: canoe
D: gear
= D
~詞義 gear（n.）大有起色(move up a gear)
~原文 When the teacher announced the upcoming exam, the entire class moved up a(n) gear and began studying far more seriously.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: bald
B: priority
C: begged
D: gazed
E: pessimistic
F: stockings

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The coach reminded the players that their ______ should be teamwork, not personal glory or individual awards.
= B
~詞義 priority（n.）優先;重點
~原文 The coach reminded the players that their priority should be teamwork, not personal glory or individual awards.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Philip ______ at Candice, attracted by her unique beauty.
= D
~詞義 gaze（v.）凝視
~原文 Philip gazed at Candice, attracted by her unique beauty.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: My father went ______ at 40. When he was forty-five years old, he had no hair on his head.
= A
~詞義 bald（adj.）禿頭的
~原文 My father went bald at 40. When he was forty-five years old, he had no hair on his head.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Every Christmas, Max and his family hang a row of ______ over the fireplace.
= F
~詞義 stocking（n.）長襪
~原文 Every Christmas, Max and his family hang a row of stockings over the fireplace.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Don't be so ______. I am sure you can succeed if you just put a little more effort into it.
= E
~詞義 pessimistic（adj.）悲觀的
~原文 Don't be so pessimistic. I am sure you can succeed if you just put a little more effort into it.

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The customer flew into a(n) ______ after waiting for half an hour, even though the delay was caused by a technical problem.
= B
~詞義 rage（n.）勃然大怒(fly into a rage)
~原文 The customer flew into a(n) rage after waiting for half an hour, even though the delay was caused by a technical problem.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ellen puts on ______ when she listens to music at work because she doesn't want to disturb her colleagues.
= E
~詞義 earphone（n.）耳機
~原文 Ellen puts on earphones when she listens to music at work because she doesn't want to disturb her colleagues.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Hiking is a form of ______ that is good for both body and mind.
= C
~詞義 recreation（n.）娛樂;消遣
~原文 Hiking is a form of recreation that is good for both body and mind.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: I keep a(n) ______ on my sofa so that I can cover my legs if I feel cold.
= F
~詞義 quilt（n.）被子
~原文 I keep a(n) quilt on my sofa so that I can cover my legs if I feel cold.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Can you please help me put some plates on the table? They are in the ______ over there.
= A
~詞義 cabinet（n.）櫥櫃
~原文 Can you please help me put some plates on the table? They are in the cabinet over there.
